12% of remote job listings now explicitly require AI skills. Here's what the numbers say about whether you should double down on them.

We analyzed 3,928 remote listings on Loker Dollar. AI appears in 487 of them. Communication is still the most-requested skill at 41% of listings, so AI is a differentiator, not a replacement.

The pay picture is mixed. Only 22% of listings disclose salary, and 78% hide it. The highest disclosed range is USD 132,400-238,400 per year at Jabil for a Sr. Principal Product Engineer. Others are quoted in CAD, like Sardine's People Ops Partner at CAD 120,000-150,000.

AI shows up beyond technical roles: sales, people ops, insurance, even a Live Ops Manager. But the premium isn't guaranteed. Communication and domain expertise still lead.

Full breakdown and how to showcase AI on your resume:
https://lokerdollar.com/en/blog/ai-skills-in-demand-for-remote-jobs-2026
